title: Project: a 10-second product promo clip

body.text: Combine everything you learned: plan a 3–4 shot storyboard, write each shot's prompt with the formula scene + action + camera + tone, render, edit together, add music and closing text, then export 9:16.

example:
Shot 1: product spinning on a flat surface
Shot 2: a hand picking it up
Shot 3: a satisfied smile
Shot 4: logo + slogan

title: Check before delivering

body.text: tone continuity, image sharpness, music timing matching the cuts, and that text is legible on mobile
. A good short clip tells its story in 10 seconds and makes the product memorable.

example: Checklist: same color tone in every shot ✓ music matches the cuts ✓ logo is clear ✓ 9:16 ratio ✓

question: What's the first thing to do in a clip project?

options.text: Plan a storyboard of what shots you need
